metadata.action_label_origin: video-derived V4 planar trajectory with manually designed height/gripper stages; robot chunks are simulation-generated

data_manifest.camera_convention: Static robot-hidden full-tabletop RGB pass; training masks never runtime inputs
data_manifest.supervision: Rendered initial RGB/masks and23 absolute XYZ/grip targets; not measured robot demonstrations

video_teacher.description: Frozen train-only real optical motion model; robot height/grip and left/right instruction labels are synthetic, not observed phone actions

all_trained_phrases: put the ring inside the bearing
place the ring inside the bearing
insert the ring into the bearing
put the ring left of the bearing
place the ring to the left of the bearing
move the ring to the left of the bearing
put the ring right of the bearing
place the ring to the right of the bearing
move the ring to the right of the bearing
decoder_prefit.method: weighted scene-feature least squares, learned word-network coefficient supervision and training-only linear-readout refinement

readout_refinement.method: float64 training-phrase least squares on learned hidden features

hyperparameters.learning_rate_schedule: cosine decay to 1 percent of initial vision learning rate; language cosine decay to 1e-5
hyperparameters.source_weighting: equal total contribution per original human source

metadata.language_scope: nine registered English phrases covering inside/left/right; no open-vocabulary claims
metadata.method: hierarchical task-specific VLA with learned visual masks and word-conditioned 23-waypoint XYZ/gripper chunk
metadata.runtime_object_coordinates: predicted from learned RGB masks only; no simulator object state input

selection.criterion: minimum maximum critical-waypoint XY error, then mean critical XY error
